actions.reason: C0005 has strong biological support from two distinct sources: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon and inflammatory pathways (SMD>1), and WXS shows significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (q=0.0044). These are independent modalities providing corroboration. Cross-modal consistency shows moderate support (median support count=3, positive silhouettes in WSI and RNA). The only confounder is a strong site enrichment (CJ), but this does not negate the biological identity; it is a technical association to weigh, not automatic drop. No supported split or merge exists, and no resolvable evidence gap remains. Accept is the best-supported action.

C0002 has biological support from two distinct sources: RNA shows extensive FDR-significant pathway enrichment (25/50 pathways, including immune downregulation and heme metabolism upregulation), and CNV shows multiple FDR-significant chromosomal losses (7p, 7q, 20p, 20q, 2p). These are independent modalities providing corroboration. Cross-modal consistency shows moderate support (median support count=2, positive WSI and RNA silhouettes, high resampling ARI=0.561). Confounder tests show no significant per-set technical associations (q=0.065 trends only). No supported split or merge exists, and no resolvable evidence gap remains. Accept is the best-supported action.

C0003 has no significant biological support in any modality (RNA, WXS, CNV all q near 1.0). The set is strongly confounded by technical factors: significant per-set associations with CT manufacturer, scanner model, and reconstruction kernel (q<0.05), and CT is the only modality with strong cohesion (median silhouette=0.276), suggesting the set is primarily defined by imaging technical variation rather than biology. Cross-modal consistency is weak in non-CT modalities. No supported split or merge exists, and no resolvable evidence gap remains. Drop is the best-supported action.
